name: Arena Wien
notes: Uses the DNN JSON endpoint /DesktopModules/WebAPI/API/Event/Search?...&pageSize=10000 that the programme page's own JS calls; one request returns all upcoming concerts (no real pagination needed). No CategoryName or price is ever populated by this API; fetching per-event detail pages for price was tried but the site's connections started timing out intermittently after a couple of requests even with retries/delay, so price_min/price_text are left null (unknown) rather than guessed. End dates are never given by the API (single-occurrence concerts), so end is always null.
